high_level_description: The image depicts a person dressed in a Minnie Mouse costume, standing outdoors at night. The individual is wearing a black strapless top with a pink polka-dotted bow at the center, which matches the skirt of the costume. The skirt is also pink with white polka dots and has a white lace trim at the hem. The person is accessorized with large hoop earrings and a bracelet on their left wrist. The background shows two other individuals walking away from the camera. One is wearing a camouflage-patterned outfit, while the other is dressed in black leather pants and a black crop top.
